Record Class EngineContributionReport.EngineEntry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.ether.society.analytics.EngineContributionReport.EngineEntry
Record Components:
engineId - unique Tier 2 engine identifier
wiringStatus - execution loop wiring classification
wiredInLoop - true if the engine executes in the current tick pipeline
globalVarianceSharePct - mean variance share across active metrics (%)
divergenceYear - first year where ablating this engine shifts any core metric by \(\ge 1\%\), or Integer.MIN_VALUE if never
mapeDeltaVsReality - \(\text{MAPE}_{\text{ablated}} - \text{MAPE}_{\text{baseline}}\) against historical reality (> 0 means engine improves empirical fit)
classification - effect tier (Dominant, Moderate, Marginal, Inert)
metricContributions - per-metric variance shares
Enclosing class:
EngineContributionReport
public static record EngineContributionReport.EngineEntry(String engineId, String wiringStatus, boolean wiredInLoop, double globalVarianceSharePct, int divergenceYear, double mapeDeltaVsReality, String classification, List<EngineContributionReport.MetricContribution> metricContributions) extends Record
Complete attribution summary for a single Tier 2 engine module.
